source.content: public class CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader implements Cache.CacheBuilder { public Object doLoad(String key) { return 'loaded:' + key; } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeCacheBuilderEvidenceTest { @isTest static void rows() { CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader loader = new CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader(); System.assertEquals('loaded:probe', loader.doLoad('probe')); Cache.OrgPartition.validateCacheBuilder(CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader.class); Cache.SessionPartition.validateCacheBuilder(CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader.class); Cache.Partition.validateCacheBuilder(CacheBuilderEvidenceLoader.class); } }
